answer.book: Othonis Casmanni's Assertio Philosophiae Christianae (Frankfurt, 1601) is a single work in two parts, Pars prior (chapters I–XXVI on Christian philosophy and its arts) and Pars posterior (a defence against critics, with numbered sophisms and disputations), preceded by two dedicatory epistles.
